country_control_definition.notes: A country is uncontrolled if neither player satisfies the control formula. Both players cannot simultaneously control a country.

discretionary.placement_policy: Any Eastern European countries subject to normal placement limits
Any Western European countries subject to normal placement limits

eras.deck_additions: Shuffle Mid War deck (Cards 36..79) into remaining draw deck at start of Turn 4
Shuffle Late War deck (Cards 80..110) into remaining draw deck at start of Turn 8

phase_sequence.logic: Deal cards from draw deck to each player until hand size reaches target (8 on T1-T3, 9 on T4-T10). If draw deck exhausts, reshuffle discards (excluding permanently removed asterisk cards) and continue dealing. China card is excluded from hand limit calculations.

Both players secretly select 1 card from hand (China Card prohibited). Cards revealed simultaneously. Higher Ops value card executes first. Ties resolved with US executing first. Scoring cards have Headline Ops = 0 and resolve second (US scoring resolves before USSR scoring on tie). Opponent event text is executed by the opponent as the phasing player.

Iterate action rounds 1..6 (Turns 1-3) or 1..7 (Turns 4-10). Each action round consists of USSR Action Round followed by US Action Round. Player plays 1 card as Event, Ops, or Space (or passes if hand is empty). 8th AR awarded to US if North Sea Oil or Space Race box 8 is active.
For each player p in {US, USSR}: deficit = max(0, state.defcon - mil_ops[p]); opponent gains deficit VPs. Reset state.us_mil_ops = 0, state.ussr_mil_ops = 0.

Check held card for each player. Tournament rule: if any player holds a Scoring Card, that player loses immediately due to accidental nuclear war. Non-scoring cards may be held into next turn (Space Race box 6 allows discarding held card).
state.turn += 1; Clear turn-persistent flags and aggregates. If state.turn == 4, shuffle Mid War cards into draw deck. If state.turn == 8, shuffle Late War cards into draw deck.

Executed after Turn 10 completes if no prior terminal state. Sequentially score Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa, Central America, South America. Europe Control gives immediate automatic victory. Add +1 VP to player holding The China Card. Determine winner by VP sign.

cost_rule.dynamic_cost_transition: If enemy control is broken during multi-point placement, subsequent influence points in the same action round cost 1 Op.

placement_restrictions: Target must be adjacent to friendly influence existing at the start of the Action Round, OR
Target must already contain friendly influence, OR
Target must be adjacent to the phasing player's Superpower home space.

op_modes.cost_rule: 1 Op per realignment attempt against a target country.
op_modes.target_condition: Target country must contain opponent influence. Friendly influence or adjacency is not required.

modifiers.condition: +1 if player has strictly more influence in target country than opponent
+1 if target country is adjacent to player's superpower home space

resolution_algorithm.outcome: High modified roll subtracts difference (High - Low) from opponent's influence in target country. Ties result in no influence change. No influence is ever added.

op_modes.cost_rule: Costs the entire card (all base Ops of the played card).
op_modes.target_condition: Target country must contain opponent influence.
op_modes.defcon_restrictions: Target country cannot be in a DEFCON-prohibited region.

resolution_algorithm.mil_ops_credit: Phasing player adds card base Ops to their Military Operations track immediately upon coup declaration.
resolution_algorithm.defcon_degradation: If target country is a Battleground, DEFCON is degraded by 1 level immediately.
resolution_algorithm.outcome: If margin > 0: Remove min(margin, target_country.opponent_influence) from opponent influence. If margin > target_country.opponent_influence, add remaining difference as friendly influence. If margin <= 0: Coup fails, no influence changed.

op_modes.cost_rule: Requires 1 card with base Ops >= required Ops for target space box.
op_modes.turn_limit: 1 space attempt per turn (increased to 2 attempts per turn if Space Race box 2 is reached).

resolution_algorithm.success_condition: Roll falls within valid range for target box.
resolution_algorithm.success_effect: Advance space race marker +1 box. Award VPs (1st or 2nd player) and special ability (1st player only).
resolution_algorithm.event_cancellation: Card event NEVER triggers when played on Space Race, regardless of superpower affiliation (serves as opponent event dump).
resolution_algorithm.discard_policy: Card is sent to discard pile (even if asterisked).

space_race_track.special_ability: May play 2 Space Race cards per turn (instead of 1).
Opponent must select and reveal Headline Event before this player selects Headline.
May discard held card at end of turn (Phase::DISCARD).
May play 8 Action Rounds per turn.

opponent_event_resolution.rule: When a card associated only with the opponent is played for Operations, the opponent's Event triggers.
opponent_event_resolution.phasing_choice: Phasing player chooses timing branch: OPS_FIRST (0) vs EVENT_FIRST (1).
opponent_event_resolution.execution_authority: The opponent executes all event decision steps as the decision player.
opponent_event_resolution.prerequisite_failure: If event cannot occur because prerequisite is unmet (e.g. NATO played before Marshall/Warsaw), event does not occur and asterisk card is sent to discard (not removed).
opponent_event_resolution.prohibition_failure: If event is prohibited by a superseding event (e.g. Arab-Israeli War after Camp David), event does not occur and card is used for Ops only (asterisk card sent to discard).
opponent_event_resolution.no_effect_execution: If event occurs but has no legal effect on the board (e.g. Alliance for Progress with no US BG), event is considered played and asterisk card IS permanently removed from game.
opponent_event_resolution.defcon_suicide_invariant: If DEFCON drops to 1 during Ops OR during Opponent Event resolution, the phasing player loses immediately.

scoring_card_invariants.mandatory_play: Scoring cards MUST be played during the turn they are drawn.
scoring_card_invariants.no_holding: Scoring cards may never be held across turns.
scoring_card_invariants.space_prohibition: Scoring cards have 0 Ops and cannot be played on the Space Race.
scoring_card_invariants.headline_ops: Scoring cards have Headline value 0 and resolve after non-scoring cards.

prohibitions: Cannot be played during Headline Phase
Cannot be played if doing so prevents playing a Scoring Card in hand
Cannot be discarded by events (e.g. Five Year Plan, Quagmire, Bear Trap)
the_china_card_invariants.turnover_rule: When played, handed face-down to opponent. Flipped face-up at end of turn.
the_china_card_invariants.endgame_bonus: Holder receives 1 VP at end of Turn 10.

degradation_rules: Any coup attempt in a Battleground country degrades DEFCON by 1 level.
Specific events degrade DEFCON (e.g. Duck and Cover, We Will Bury You, Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007, Olympic Games boycott).
DEFCON cannot degrade below 1 (1 = terminal loss).
improvement_rules: At Phase A of every turn, if DEFCON < 5, DEFCON improves by +1.
Specific events improve DEFCON (e.g. SALT Negotiations, ABM Treaty, How I Learned to Stop Worrying).

automatic_victory_conditions.predicate: Player has Control of Europe during Europe Scoring or Final Scoring
Player holds a Scoring Card at end of turn
Player plays #107 Wargames at DEFCON 2 and pays 6 VP

sequence: Award +1 VP to holder of The China Card
endgame_scoring_turn_10.determination: If VP > 0: US wins. If VP < 0: USSR wins. If VP == 0: Draw.
